evidence.quote: Kenneth Walker III (Seahawks) took four carries against the Rams before leaving with an oblique injury.
Rookie Zach Charbonnet, who entered Week 11 with just over 200 rushing yards on the year, replaced Walker as Seattle's top ball carrier.
